role.altitude: She still measures the roof, decides waste and method, accepts or rewrites the estimate, and tells the customer. She stops hunting coverage rates and retyping the arithmetic when the rate card is complete. She does not gain a right to let the list or calculated estimate v1 stand as the quote, or to send an order.
skills_to_grow: Estimate materials and labor by hand when a rate row is missing
role.ambitious_version: She still measures every roof. A blank rate stays a hand estimate. An unaccepted calculation is not the quote, and she still tells the customer herself.

tasks.short: Estimate materials and labor required to complete a roofing job.

steps.what: Measure this roofing job in person before the estimate.
List stored coverage and labor hours for this roofing type.
Decide the labor and waste required for this roof.
Fill calculated estimate v1 of materials and labor required.
Check the materials and labor still mean this roof.
Write the estimate required to complete this roofing job, or correct it.
Tell the customer the materials and labor estimate.

tasks.design: She measures the roof in person and decides the waste and method. {DOCS} lists the stored coverage and labor-hour rates for that roofing type, and a separate step fills calculated estimate v1 from her area, her waste decision and those rates only. She checks that the quantities still mean the roof, writes the estimate she keeps, and tells the customer herself; the list and the fill do not raise an out-of-range alert, do not send an order, and do not file the quote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage and labor hours sat in a notebook or a colleague's memory, and each roof's area is different, so the arithmetic was redone by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored rate row can multiply a measured area by coverage, labor hours and a waste percent she has already chosen.
tasks.still_hard: Pitch, access and penetrations are on the building. A wrong quantity becomes a short load or a bad quote.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person who has seen this roof. A rate row cannot judge access or tell the customer what the job will take.
tasks.altitude: Her week still spends most of its time on the roof and on the customer. She no longer hunts rates or retypes the arithmetic when the card is complete. She does not gain a right to let calculated estimate v1 stand as the quote.

reach.task: Keep the rate card for each roofing type
reach.learn: Which coverage and labor-hour row matches this roof

reach.task: Confirm access and method before the crew starts
reach.learn: Which waste decision she made for this roof

evidence.claim: WOR art. 27(1)(l) treats hours, location and job logs per fitter as observation of presence and performance, which needs works council consent. Labor hours for one roofing job are not that log.

Annex III 4(b) is high-risk where an AI system allocates tasks based on individual behaviour or personal traits, or evaluates worker performance. Hours from roof type and area are not that ranking, and this design does not rank roofers.

The range is a scenario, not a measured saving. A week of blank rate cards saves nothing. A week of complete cards saves only the list and the arithmetic. Measuring, deciding, checking, writing and telling stay. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The rate card fields are material name, coverage per pack, labor hours per square metre, waste percent, unit cost and roofing type. The buyer maintains that row in {DOCS} outside this task, and that upkeep is not counted here.
If any of those fields is blank, the list returns nothing and the fill does not run. She estimates materials and labor by hand in the write step, and that write stays at full time.
Her area, pitch, access and penetrations are not stored before she measures them in this task. Unit cost is a field on the rate card, not a live finance pull.
Labor hours are for the job, not a named person's score. The design does not rank roofers, log individual speed, or track vans.

The list does not raise an out-of-range alert. The fill writes calculated estimate v1 and does not send an order, does not file the quote, and does not become the kept estimate. She writes the estimate she keeps and tells the customer herself. A change after the check voids ap-est, and she finishes that estimate by hand.
Upkeep of 0.3 hours per 100 baseline hours is her share of telling the buyer when a rate row is wrong. The design keeps no score of her corrections.
unknowns: Whether this firm keeps a rate card by roofing type.
How often a roof has a blank rate or a shape the card cannot price.
research_questions: For quotes last month, how often were coverage and labor hours per square metre already on a rate card before she measured?

incremental.description: Tell the buyer when a rate row is wrong so the next list is current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week of roofs with a blank rate card, so the fill does not run and she estimates by hand. High is a week where every card is complete: only the list and the arithmetic go, and measuring, deciding, checking, writing and telling stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
